name: @ozjsey/v-fit-children
description: Vue directive that auto-hides children that don't fit within a container's width. Useful for chips, badges, tags, and other inline elements in tight spaces.
author: Ozgur Seyidoglu

scripts.build: tsup vFitChildren.ts --format esm,cjs --minify --sourcemap --dts --out-dir dist --clean && mv dist/vFitChildren.js dist/vFitChildren.min.js && mv dist/vFitChildren.js.map dist/vFitChildren.min.js.map && mv dist/vFitChildren.cjs dist/vFitChildren.min.cjs && mv dist/vFitChildren.cjs.map dist/vFitChildren.min.cjs.map && mv dist/vFitChildren.d.cts dist/vFitChildren.min.d.cts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['vFitChildren.min.js','vFitChildren.min.cjs']){const p='dist/'+f;let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/\/\/# sourceMappingURL=vFitChildren\.(js|cjs)\.map/, '//# sourceMappingURL='+f+'.map');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);}"
